outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns its fingers with the handle (frames 35–76, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, visibly exposing its side and interior gap (frames 90–101, image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases and withdraws while the drawer remains open through frame 150 (frames 120–150, wrist_image, image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended displacement of surrounding objects is visible.
